fixed-kdk-v1.description: Existing fixed-step Leapfrog KDK on physical coordinates with Plummer softening; the sole production integrator
fixed-kdk-v1.evidence: KdkDynamicsTest and KdkNumericalTest on the strict lane

comoving-kdk-v2.description: Cosmological Leapfrog KDK on co-moving coordinates with canonical comoving momentum; the retained expanding-universe integrator

variables.x: co-moving position (SoA positions), x = r_physical / a
variables.w: canonical comoving momentum w = a * v stored directly in the SoA velocity field; physical peculiar velocity is v = w / a
variables.a: scale factor from a background expansion model

comoving-kdk-v2.evidence: ComovingBackgroundTest and ComovingLeapfrogTest on the strict lane (TST-P1-010, TST-P1-011)

block-kdk-schedule-v1.evidence: plan/block_time.json; the scheduling proxy stays a P1 evidence boundary and is not promoted

rejected.block_time_promotion: rejection re-recorded from plan/block_time.json; promotion needs force-state, MPI, restart, and end-to-end evidence
rejected.variable_step_individual_timesteps: reject: no production force-state coupling, MPI halo and migration, or restart/rollback evidence exists
rejected.higher_order_symplectic_fixed_step: reject: no demonstrated product need; fixed KDK keeps the gravity phase space
rejected.explicit_runge_kutta: reject: non-symplectic with no accepted energy behavior
rejected.implicit_integrators: reject: no product requirement justifies the cost
rejected.imported_gadget_scheme: reject: clean-room forbids an imported implementation; the co-moving scheme is defined by this contract only

frames.physical: dv/dt = -(g / a) - h * v, with the homogeneous Hubble drag h * v subtracted from the peculiar acceleration g from the existing solver path on co-moving coordinates with the existing Plummer softening
frames.integrated: w = a * v and dw/dt = -g: the canonical momentum removes the Hubble drag from the kick explicitly, so only the peculiar field drives w; v = w / a

comoving_leapfrog_contract.kdk_sequence: kick w += (dt / 2) * g, then drift x += dtau * w with dtau = ComovingDrift(a, t, t + dt) = integral of dt / a over the step, then symmetric kick
comoving_leapfrog_contract.static_background_degeneracy: with a(t) == 1 the background is Static: a == 1, h == 0, dtau == dt exactly, and the comoving integrator reproduces fixed KDK bit-exactly
comoving_leapfrog_contract.state_ownership: particle state stays in the existing SoA ParticleBuffer; the canonical momentum w occupies the existing velocity field; background (a, h) and cosmic time are per-run execution inputs owned by the integration step, never by particles or solvers
conservation_targets: empty-universe invariant: w = a * v is exactly constant because g == 0 implies the kicks add zero; verified bit-exact over the oracle run
expanding two-body configs converge at second order against a fine-step reference at identical softening (energy-like invariant bounded)
static parity: the comoving integrator and fixed KDK produce bit-identical trajectories on symmetric inputs
interface_rules: reuse the SolverForceEvaluation boundary exactly; no new solver entry point
same argument-count and no-hot-path-allocation rules as fixed KDK; no dynamic allocation after warmup
checkpoint capture, rollback, and finite-state validation behave identically to fixed KDK (cosmic time is additionally rolled back)
compatible with Direct, Barnes-Hut, FMM, KIFMM, PM, TreePM through the force-evaluation boundary
periodic boundaries remain a solver-domain concern; the integrator stays domain-agnostic
